prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a new original One Ring hobbit culture scene: exactly FOUR hobbits sneaking through a farmer's field, well away from the road. Wide 16:9 landscape, final export 2560x1440. The four small adult hobbits are recognizable by short stature, curly hair, simple cloaks and waistcoats, travel packs and large bare hairy feet. They crouch and move carefully in a loose single-file group through tall ripening grain and broad-leaf crops in the lower-left and central foreground, quietly parting the stalks and glancing around. All four clearly visible and countable, separate silhouettes, no fifth person, no children, no heroic combat pose. Their faces and clothes are heavily shrouded in shadow, nearly dark olive-charcoal silhouettes with just a few muted edge-light marks. Show a wide peaceful but suspenseful rural landscape of rolling cultivated fields, low hedges and scattered trees, an old small farmhouse or barn far away near the horizon. A winding country road is a tiny PALE DISTANT THREAD on a far hillside beyond multiple fields, visibly very far from the hobbits, never a path beside or under their feet. The scene is entirely in the field. Low late-evening light glows through a hazy amber-gray sky, lighting the far crops and landscape more brightly than the foreground hobbits; foreground crop masses and shadowed trees naturally frame the image. Mood: furtive, pastoral, adventurous, quietly tense, an ordinary farm seen on an extraordinary journey. Palette: desaturated moss and olive greens, deep charcoal and umber shadows, muted golden straw and warm hazy ivory light, sparse slate-blue distance. REQUIRED ART STYLE: extremely broad thick expressive gouache and oil-like paint strokes, rough palette-knife blocks, dragged broken paint edges, scraped scumbled pigment textures, bold simplified large shapes and lost edges, evocative traditional dark fantasy book painting. Avoid realistic detail: no crisp facial features, readable eyes, individual hair strands, carefully outlined crop stalks, tiny fabric patterns, detailed masonry, polished 3D or glossy realism. Use a few broad marks to suggest each hobbit and crop group. Strong dramatic value structure: the environment is brighter than the people, who stay concealed in deep shadow. Grounded understated Middle-earth clothing and farmland, no magical lights or fantastical architecture. Full bleed rectangular artwork, no captions, letters, writing, logo, border, white strip, black bars or UI.
